about: A dataset of real token-stream recordings: one prompt, six local models, ten runs each (the first after unloading the model), recorded on 2026-11-11 by record-traces.mjs on a laptop with an NVIDIA RTX 3500 Ada Laptop GPU (12 GB) and Ollama 0.40.15, num_ctx 8192, temperature 0.7, seeds 101 to 110. The machine was shared with other work: runs where the model had been evicted say so. Model text is verbatim.

schema.chunks: [t_ms, kind, text], kind a = answer, t = thinking
schema.final: Ollama /api/chat final line, durations in ns

changelog.change: 60 runs: llama3.1:8b, mistral:7b, qwen3:8b, qwen3:4b, qwen3:0.6b, phi4-mini:3.8b, 10 each.
